props.label: Ended

props.label: Run Production Time
props.description:
Run Time (seconds) Aggregation:

The aggregation looks at workcenterHistory records, that fall between the productionRun.startAt and productionRun.endAt to determine based on the Events (not Modes) whether the time was spend up, or down.

Planned Production Time = resource shift availability (total hours) between productionRun.startAt & productionRun.EndAt (do not excluded plannedDowntime, include all 'avialable' time); Planned Prod Time is always based on the calendar Available time for the workcenter. User must adjust the calendar - when appropriate to adjust the planned production time.

Run Time = Planned Production Time (Minus)-

workcenterHistory records where PlannedDowntime Or UnPlannedDowntime ==1

props.label: Run Cycle Time
props.description:
Average Cycle time (seconds)

((produced + scrap) / RunTime

props.label: Total Good Units
props.description:
Total produced where includeInProductionCounts = 1

This  is the total throughput for the entire production run in good units made.

props.label: Total Scrap Units

props.label: Run Quality

scrap / totalProduction
